published_source: Printed Table 4, column (1) of the published article (papers/mnsc/mnsc.2025.03238.pdf, Articles in Advance p. 7), read Nov 4 2026: DSIB 0.014** (0.006), Observations 234,609, R2 0.614, firm x year and bank x firm FE, no controls; equals the authors' code output 0.013696 (0.0055677), N 234,609, to the printed decimals. Earlier: Authors' shipped replication.log line 1355 (reghdfe output of code_main_tables.do line 239 on the shipped data); README quotes 0.0137 as the actual DiD estimate. Article PDF not available in the project.
replication_status: exact (authors' code output 0.013696 (0.0055677), N 234,609, equals printed Table 4 column (1) 0.014 (0.006), N 234,609, to the printed decimals; fixest reproduces the shipped replication.log value; verified against the article Nov 4 2026)
notes: code_main_tables.do line 239: reghdfe new_default sib_ind if year>=2010 & year<=2020, absorb(firmcode##year creditorcode##firmcode) cluster(creditorcode). Data: Intermediate dta/MCA_Default_Yearly v2.dta, 2010-2020 (356,787 bank-firm-years, 46 banks, 21,101 firms, 55,966 pairs); prepared copy t4_panel.rds adds pair_id (= creditorcode x firmcode, the unit) and g_bank (bank DSIB designation year: 2016 for SBI 236328 and ICICI 96379, 2018 for HDFC 88297, NA for 43 never-designated banks); sib_ind == 1[year >= g_bank] on every row, no switch-offs. xt_vars firmcode reproduces the authors' firmcode##year FE (TWFE/BJS: id + year + year^firmcode); the pair panel is unbalanced so CSA uses the project's composition-fixed manual cells and ignores xt (csa_note xt_ignored). fixest replication: 0.01369597 (SE 0.0055677, N 234,609 with fixef.rm = 'singleton'; SE 0.0067751, N 356,787 keeping singletons as run_spec does) = exact. SD(new_default) = 0.1225791 in the 356,787 sample used by run_spec (0.1213632 in the 234,609 reghdfe sample), so the standardized published coefficient is 0.11173 (0.11285). Cohorts: 2016 (2 banks, 9,133 pairs, 62,762 obs) and 2018 (1 bank, 5,279 pairs, 31,213 obs); 73.7% of obs never treated; 2,678 treated-bank pairs (7,568 obs) are first observed at or after designation (always treated within their own window; they carry no identifying variation under pair FE). Only 3 treated clusters of 46, so the leverage screen is expected to fail. Same design is also estimated by the authors with Sun-Abraham IW (code_figures.do lines 119-128, eventstudyinteract on sib_ind): 0.0139235 (SE 0.0012875) with never-treated controls and 0.019098 (0.0014855) with the last cohort as control; whether these appear in the article text is unverified (no article text), so they are recorded here rather than as separate specs. Appendix A2 (line 127) and A5 column 1 re-run the same regression (A5 with bank and firm double clustering, SE 0.0050614).
